dedupe_keys.name: dataset of an airline driven flight rescheduling problem

description: Dataset of an airline-driven flight rescheduling problem is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Young-Bin Woo. This data was derived from Luo and Yu (1997), Bard and Mohan (2008), and Brunner (2014). The data is from American Airlines’ daily flight schedule at the Dallas/Fort Worth Airport. There are 71 flights in GDP and the GDP spanned three hours in duration. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
